title: When the Border Falls
author: Vesper Ravensworth
blurb: Dominic Joubert, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, has spent three years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
